notes: policyengine-uk 2.165.1 ships the OBR October 2026 forecast as its native growth rates. Every simulation, baseline and reform alike, retains src/uk_budget_data/forecast/obr_october_2026.json over those rates. The overlay sets the same values for CPI, RPI, CPIH, average earnings, rents, mortgage interest, non-labour income, council tax and the September CPI and May to July earnings gaps. Its per-capita GDP, mixed income and non-labour income rates subtract an older population path from aggregate growth. Household weights use the installed model's October population path. The overlay's per-capita incomes, house prices, social rents and CPI after housing costs differ from the engine's by up to 0.3 points a year. Series the overlay does not list keep what the installed model ships; the receipt records the exact model version.
